inventory.description: The inventory the issues were derived from.

issues.description: Issues sorted by severity, then skill, then kind.

projects.description: Projects that were covered, sorted by canonical path.

observations.description: Notes about skipped roots and other facts.

unread_roots.description:
Every path prefix this run could not read: a whole root (a budget
overrun before the root was reached, or a `read_dir` error on the
root itself), or a single skill directory whose `SKILL.md` was
unreadable within an otherwise-readable root - the set a caller
merging this result into a previous one must scope a carried-over
deployment to.

InstalledSkillDto.description: One skill with all of its deployments.

description.description: Description from the first readable deployment.

SkillName.description:
Lexical skill name: the directory name that holds `SKILL.md`.

Invariant: two deployments with the same `SkillName` are the same skill,
even when their bytes differ. A symlink alias with another name is another
skill.

DeploymentDto.description:
One installed copy or link of a skill.

Invariant: `harness` is an [`AgentId`] or `None` for the universal and
parked roots; it is never a display string. `plugin` is `Some` exactly
when `root.kind` is [`crate::identity::RootKind::PluginCache`].

harness.description: Harness that owns the root, when it is a harness root.

path.description: Absolute lexical path of the skill directory.

link_target.description: Link target, when the deployment is a symlink.

shared_via_whole_dir_link.description: True when the skills root itself is a link into the universal root.

is_symlink.description: True when the deployment's own directory entry is a symlink.

resolved_path.description:
Canonicalized directory the deployment resolves to, when that is
meaningfully different from `path`. Distinct from `link_target`:
`link_target` is the symlink's own target, while `resolved_path` is
`None` for an ordinary directory that canonicalizes to itself or for
a symlink whose target does not resolve.

symlink_is_broken.description: True when the deployment is a symlink whose target does not resolve.

symlink_error.description: Error reading the symlink target, when one occurred.

owner_id.description: Owner id, when a ledger owns it.

content_fingerprint.description: Content fingerprint over the directory tree.

disabled_by.description: Why the deployment is off, when it is.

disabled_readers.description: Readers of a universal deployment that have it disabled.

plugin.description: Plugin provenance for a plugin-cache deployment.

frontmatter.description: Parsed `SKILL.md` frontmatter, when the file parsed.

has_spec.description: True when the SKILL.md matches the getsentry/skillet spec pattern.

folder_bytes.description: Total bytes read while walking the skill folder.

file_count.description: Total files counted while walking the skill folder.

skill_md_tokens.description: Token count of the whole `SKILL.md` file.

description_tokens.description:
Token count of just `"{name}: {description}"` - the prompt cost the
model actually pays per turn, as opposed to `skill_md_tokens` which
counts the whole file.

content_hash.description:
sha256 over the sorted (relative path, bytes) pairs of the skill
folder. Distinct from `content_fingerprint`: a different, whole-folder
scheme kept for parity with the desktop's `SkillCandidate`.

modified_at.description: RFC3339 of the newest file mtime in the skill folder.

folder_truncated.description:
True when the folder walk hit the file-count or byte cap and stopped
early - `folder_bytes`/`file_count`/`content_hash` are partial.

in_git_repo.description:
True when the skill's directory sits inside a git working tree (a
`.git` file or directory on some ancestor). Distinguishes a
version-controlled directory from a genuinely unmanaged one - see
[`SourceKind::InRepo`].

studio_disabled.description:
True when this deployment was found inside a root's
`.skill-studio-disabled/` holding directory. Maps to `disabled_by ==
Some(DisabledBy::StudioMoved)`.

parked_origin.description:
For a parked copy, the root it came from and returns to: the scope
(with the project path) and `Universal` or the agent's own root.
`None` for a copy that is not parked.

DeploymentId.description:
Opaque deployment id.

Invariant: the string starts with `dep:v1/`. Its internal layout is a core
detail; adapters and the UI compare it as a string and never split it.

RootRef.description:
A root, before it is resolved on disk.

Invariant: `(scope, kind)` is unique inside one normalized scope, and
`Parked` exists only at `Global`. `RootRef::new` enforces the second
rule; `scan` rejects a deserialized value that breaks it with
[`ErrorCode::InvalidRequest`] through [`RootRef::validate`].

kind.description: Harness, universal, parked, legacy, or plugin cache.

ProjectRef.description:
Absolute path of a tracked project directory.

Invariant: the path is canonical inside a [`crate::scope::NormalizedScope`].
Wire values are the lexical path the caller gave.

RootKind.description: What kind of root a path is.

oneOf.description: A legacy directory a harness still reads (`OpenCode` `skill/`).
A plugin cache the harness ships skills in.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `open-code`.

Invariant: the string is the serde wire name used by the desktop app
today. `open-code` is canonical; `opencode` is only a CLI binary name and
is never stored in an `AgentId`.

BackingRelationship.description: How a deployment is wired to its bytes.

oneOf.description: A copy that no longer tracks its source.

DeploymentMutability.description: Whether Skill Studio may change a deployment in place.

oneOf.description: Plugin caches and managed ledgers: writes are refused.

LifecycleOwnerKind.description: Which ledger owns a deployment's lifecycle.

oneOf.description: A copy install recorded by Skill Studio.
A fork recorded by Skill Studio.
More than one ledger claims the name.

OwnerId.description:
Opaque lifecycle owner id.

Invariant: the string starts with `owner:v1/`. It names the ledger entry
that installed the skill, not a path.

Fingerprint.description:
Content fingerprint in the `sha256:<hex>` form.

Invariant: the hex is lowercase and 64 characters long. One scheme covers
files, trees, and proposals; the old untyped hex form is parsed on read.

DisabledBy.description:
Why a deployment is off, as shown to the user.

Invariant: the first four names match the desktop wire today; the last
two are new and only appear once the matching mechanism is supported.

oneOf.description: The Claude Code per-skill link was removed.
Skill Studio moved the folder aside.

PluginSourceDto.description:
Where a plugin-cache deployment came from, per the agent-plugins.org
manifest convention (`<cache>/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/skills/`).

version.description: Version directory name, when the layout has one.

enabled.description:
Claude Code's `enabledPlugins["<plugin>@<marketplace>"]` state:
`Some(false)` when the harness has the plugin switched off,
`Some(true)` when switched on, `None` when the harness records
nothing for it (including every non-Claude-Code harness).

SkillFrontmatter.description:
`SKILL.md` frontmatter, per the agentskills.io spec. Unknown keys are
ignored by default serde behavior, so agent-specific extensions in a
skill's frontmatter don't break parsing.

name.description:
Required by spec: 1-64 chars, lowercase a-z0-9 and hyphens, must
match the parent directory name.

compatibility.description: Optional, spec caps this at 500 chars.

metadata.description: Tolerate non-string metadata values (numbers, lists, nested maps).

disable-model-invocation.description:
Claude Code / pi extension: restricts this skill to explicit
invocation only (`/name`, `/skill:name`), hiding it from the model's
own auto-invoke matching. See [`InvocationPolicy`].

user-invocable.description:
Claude Code / pi extension: `false` restricts this skill to model
auto-invoke only, hiding it from explicit `/name` invocation. See
[`InvocationPolicy`].

SourceKind.description:
How a skill made it onto disk.

Ported from the desktop's `provenance::SourceKind`. Serializes to the same
kebab-case strings the frontend has always used. Declaration order doubles
as precedence order (dotagents beats plugin beats skills-sh beats in-repo
beats manual) via the derived `Ord`, matching the desktop's
`classify_source_kind`.

oneOf.description: Present in the skills.sh lock file.

A plain directory with no skill-manager provenance, but sitting
inside a git working tree.
A plain directory with no other provenance signal.

Detached from its dotagents/skills.sh ledger via "Fork" so local
edits survive `sync`/`update`. Never produced by classification
directly; assigned afterward from the fork registry.

Completeness.description: Whether a scan saw everything it was asked to see.

Observation.description: Something worth telling the caller that is not an error.

root.description: Root the observation is about, when there is one.

deployment_id.description: Deployment the issue belongs to, when it is deployment-specific.

IssueKind.description: Structured issue kind. New kinds may be added; names never change.

oneOf.description: A symlink whose target is missing.
A link Skill Studio could not read.
A spec rule is violated (message says which).
Frontmatter that a repair proposal can fix.
Two deployments of one name have different bytes.
The same name is installed twice in one scope.
The deployment is disabled for a reader.
A root could not be read inside the budget.

Severity.description:
How serious an issue is.

Invariant: `Error` blocks a mutation on the deployment; `Warning` does
not; `Off` is informational (the deployment is intentionally disabled).

oneOf.description: Must be fixed before the deployment can be changed.

NextAction.description: What the user can do about an issue.

oneOf.description: Remove or relink the broken link.
Restore the parked or disabled deployment.
Rescan with a longer read budget.
